_comment: Chapter 05 obstacle list -- input to map_clean.py.
Position is the top-left tile of the footprint, 1-based; values <= 0 or past
the board mean the object is only partly on screen.
Size is optional and defaults to the model's VOX SIZE / 24; it is spelled out
here only where the painted art covers a different rectangle than the model box.
The village is a town map, so nearly everything on it is a building. The two
widest -- the cathedral along the top-left and the church in the top-right --
are each too wide for a single .vox (255 voxels = 10 tiles), so each is two
models standing side by side; see build_obstacles_05.py.
Three buildings run off an edge of the map and show one column of themselves.
Each reuses a whole model placed off the board, with a Size that clips the
cleaning back to the tiles the art actually covers.
